# Epoch

> Time estimation MCP server for AI agents.

Epoch gives AI agents 24 structured tools for grounded time estimation, calendar math, PERT, COCOMO II, Monte Carlo simulation, sprint forecasting, token-to-time mapping, model cost comparison, schedule risk, and feedback-based calibration.

## Use cases
- AI agent time estimation
- PERT and COCOMO II estimates
- Monte Carlo schedule simulation
- Sprint forecasting and critical path analysis
- Business-day and timezone calculations
- LLM token cost and model comparison
- Estimate calibration from actuals
- Agent skill workflows for choosing the right Epoch MCP or CLI tool

## Key paths
- `README.md`: public overview and quick start
- `docs/llms.txt`: expanded AI-readable tool reference
- `skills/epoch/SKILL.md`: public agent skill for time, cost, schedule, and feedback workflows
- `src/`: MCP server, CLI, REST API, and estimation engines
- `package.json`: npm package metadata for `@kyanitelabs/epoch`

## Agent skill
Invoke `$epoch` in compatible agent hosts when the user needs grounded duration estimates, calendar math, token/model cost comparison, deadline risk, or actuals recording. The skill tells the agent when to use the MCP server, the CLI, or the feedback loop.

## Telemetry (opt-in, agent-aware)
Epoch can contribute anonymized estimate/actual pairs (7 fields, no code, no paths, no prompts, date-only) to a community calibration dataset at `https://telemetry.kyanitelabs.tech/v1/telemetry`. It is OFF by default. Humans opt in with `epoch telemetry enable`; agent/headless operators opt in by setting `EPOCH_TELEMETRY=1` in the server environment (e.g. the `env` block of the MCP server config). There is deliberately NO MCP tool to enable telemetry — an agent must not self-consent; consent belongs to the operator. `epoch telemetry preview` shows the exact payload before anything is sent. Schema v2 records the client runtime (client_name/client_version/transport) so agent usage is counted as first-class. Full policy: `docs/TELEMETRY.md`, `docs/PRIVACY.md`.

## MCP Registry

Epoch is listed on the [official MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/servers/io.github.KyaniteLabs/Epoch) as `io.github.KyaniteLabs/Epoch`. Registry metadata is in `server.json` at the repo root.
